hero.sub: A co-designed online toolkit providing evidence-based resources, clinical support, and community for therapists working toward one goal: reducing suicidal thoughts and behaviors in youth — built for and by therapists.

discoverOutcomes.text: What we heard from Rise therapists

news.linkText: Expanding tools for therapists supporting suicidal youth
news.source: CU Boulder Office for Outreach and Community Engagement

tour.heading: Eight tools, one goal
tour.intro: Supporting clinicians to best reduce suicidal thoughts and behaviors of the youth they serve.

tools.title: Treatment Roadmap
tools.tagline: The three phases of a Rise treatment at a glance, with the tools and sample interventions for each.
tools.useWhen: At the start of treatment and each new phase

tools.title: Treatment Planning Tool
tools.tagline: Map your client's risk and protective factors, choose interventions, and build a three-phase plan.

tools.title: Make A Safety Plan
tools.tagline: Build a safety plan with your client and print a copy for them to keep.
tools.useWhen: Early on, and whenever risk changes

tools.title: Treatment Library
tools.tagline: Evidence-based practices, worksheets, handouts and assessment tools for your sessions.
tools.useWhen: When planning treatment and preparing for sessions

tools.title: Community Resources
tools.tagline: Referrals for follow-up care after Rise, plus community supports for youth, families and therapists.
tools.useWhen: When linking your client to their next step in care

tools.title: Navigating Schools
tools.tagline: Tips, an interview guide, and school and contact cards for working with schools.
tools.useWhen: Before your first visit to a new school

tools.title: Self-Care & Support
tools.tagline: Grounding practices, self-care tips and a wall of wins, for you.
tools.useWhen: Any time, not just when things feel hard

tools.title: Consultation
tools.tagline: Talk through a case, get guidance on risk, or reach the Rise team.
tools.useWhen: When a case, or a week, feels heavy
